correctness.rationale: For fixed integer k≥4, t>0, q=tN^(−1/(k−1)), the exponential-spacing representation gives Gamma(k−1,1) single-window probability q^(k−1)/(k−1)!−(k−1)q^k/k!+O(q^(k+1)). Direct integration of adjacent joint small-window event over k−2 shared exponentials yields 2q^k/k!+O(q^(k+1)). Thus new-cluster intensity λ−(k+1)t^k N^(−1/(k−1))/k!+O(N^(−2/(k−1))). For start indicators overlapping at most k bins, nonadjacent simultaneous starts are O(q^(k+1)) and Chen–Stein total-variation error is O(N^-1+N^(−2/(k−1)))=o(N^(−1/(k−1))); the all-window exception is exponentially small. Gamma concentration of T_N/N and a deterministic sandwich choose exponent 1/(k−1)<a<1/2 (possible precisely k≥4), giving the same signed expansion for circle spacings. Reviewed attached exact-rational 145 algebraic coefficient checks for k=4..32; these are supportive only, not the asymptotic proof.
